items.title: Prepare fewer portions for Friday dinners
items.description: Friday dinners had a 30% unsold share versus 20% in comparable services (+10.0 pp over 12 days). Try lowering planned portions for Friday dinner and check the simulator before changing the plan.

limitations: Opportunities are indicative and are not guaranteed savings.
Opportunities of overlapping actions must not be summed.
Associated factors are not proven causes.
